rows.reason: Base union behind `BadgeVariant`, `TagVariant` and `AvatarVariant` (and `AvatarProps.variant` through the last). Under owner disposition D-B (2026-10-07) those six are canonical for the measured `secondary`/`gradient` structural fills and are no longer deprecated; they remain built on this deprecated shared union, and its terminal disposition is pending an owner decision. Transferred to WO-RET-06 at the RET-01 closure (E11): parity failed with a fixture (prop-renamed/badge-variant-secondary), removal recorded for the 4.0 line. `Variant` answers through the alias `export type BadgeVariant = Variant` (the row keeps that consumer needle); it has three dependents — BadgeVariant, TagVariant and AvatarVariant — and leaves last: repairing Badge parity does not release it while Tag or Avatar still build on it.
rows.scope: Exported type alias. Inside the package only the badge, tag and avatar contracts import it. No direct import of the name was found in the three apps; it is reached through the three component variant types.
